text.jp:
ジェイクは物理攻撃力が高いアタッカーで、
物理攻撃を得意とするビジョンと相性がいいです。

彼は、"強運"を味方につけて戦います。

バトル中に「コイントス」など、特定の技を使うことで
強運の値を上げていくことができます。

強運が高いほど、クリティカル率が上昇するほか
強運が一定以上ないと使えない技も存在します。

一部の技には、使うことで強運が減るものもあるので
うまく運を味方につけながら、立ち回ってみてください。
text.official_en:
Jake is a heavy hitter with high physical attack, making
him an ideal match for visions that specialize in
physical attacks.
He does battle with lady luck as his ally, and certain
skills—like Coin Toss—will increase his luck level.
The higher his luck level, the more likely he is to deal
critical damage.
Additionally, some skills only unlock when his luck
level reaches a certain threshold. Be careful, though:
some skills will decrease his luck level! Do your best
to keep lady luck on your side and win the day!
text.real_en:
Jake is a heavy hitter with high physical attack, making
him an ideal match for visions that specialize in
physical attacks.
He does battle with lady luck as his ally, and certain
skills—like Coin Toss—will increase his luck level.
The higher his luck level, the more likely he is to deal
critical damage.
Additionally, some skills can only be used when his luck
level is high enough. Be careful, though:
some skills will decrease his luck level! Do your best
to keep lady luck on your side and win the day!
